# Public synthetic cloud fixture

This fixed RSS publication and generated PNG exercise normal public-source
collection during an explicitly authorized cloud acceptance run. They contain no
personal data, require no provider account and need no AI processing.

The production downloader intentionally rejects private Docker addresses. Use
this fixture's public raw GitHub URL rather than weakening that boundary.
Keep theses/filter processing disabled for the check and turn work off after it.
Use only a fresh/synthetic acceptance library; remove the test feed after the
persistence, backup and deployment checks finish.

These files are excluded from the reader image by the build-context allowlist.
